policy: Preserve every verified move and all previously expanded move access. Keep natural/thematic level-up, canonical breeding and existing machine routes. Teach every remaining verified compatible move through the existing Blackthorn move tutor. Goldenrod remains limited to its original five utility moves. No supported move is excluded for lacking a thematic natural or egg placement.
